BeforeSideTurnStart.issue: C#'s Hook.BeforeSideTurnStart is audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 9 -- it fires for BOTH sides BEFORE any block is cleared. The sim has no such slot; `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order` shows on_player_turn_start executes AFTER on_block_cleared and on_energy_reset, i.e. step ~18. That record's step 9 verdicts the mechanism a gap, lists **Kunai by name** among the 26 ported implementers, and labels the player-side half DORMANT because every ported one is a per-turn counter reset that reads neither block nor energy. One verdict per mechanism (binding rule 3), so this entry reproduces it rather than re-deriving it. Kunai's body here is exactly that shape: `AttacksPlayedThisTurn = 0` plus a Status write. DORMANT: porting a relic or power whose BeforeSideTurnStart reads block or energy, or an ENEMY-side listener (turn_structure guard G5), makes it live. The `participants.Contains(base.Owner.Creature)` filter is structurally satisfied -- on_player_turn_start is only fired for the player side (hooks.py:279-283). Rule 7: hooks.py and audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json are not hashed by this record.

AfterCardPlayed.maps_to: on_card_played (sts2_rl/relics/kunai.py), fired once per Replay iteration by CombatState._resolve_card_play (sts2_rl/combat.py:597-600)
AfterCardPlayed.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the hook bracket is per CardPlay now. CombatState._resolve_card_play opens `for play_index in range(play_count)` and fires `hooks.before_card_played` INSIDE it (sts2_rl/combat.py:574-576) and `hooks.on_card_played` at the end of each iteration, gated on the combat still being in progress (sts2_rl/combat.py:597-600) -- CardModel.cs:1904-1965's `for (int i = 0; i < playCount; i++)` with Hook.BeforeCardPlayed at :1929 and Hook.AfterCardPlayed at :1957-1959. A replayed card therefore fires both hooks once per iteration, as in the game. WAS: combat.py bracketed the WHOLE play-count loop, so a Throwing-Axe-doubled card fired each hook once. The arithmetic (Attack filter, increment, `% 3 == 0`, Dexterity 1 on the owner) already matched.

AfterCombatEnd.maps_to: no counterpart; on_player_turn_start (kunai.py:26-27) is the only reset
AfterCombatEnd.rationale: Kunai.cs:123-129 zeroes AttacksPlayedThisTurn (and the two presentation fields) at combat end as well as at turn start; the sim keeps only the turn-start half. `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset` classifies Kunai in the 'reset at a TURN boundary only' bucket, which is the relic/art_of_war shape, and PROMPT.md bug class 13 requires tracing to the first READER before verdicting. Done: the only reader of _attacks_this_turn is on_card_played (kunai.py:32-33), and a card can only be played in the play phase, which turn_structure step 28 opens AFTER the turn-start hooks. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-turn-reset): the same instance carried out of a combat with _attacks_this_turn=2 reports 0 at combat 2 turn 1, identical to a freshly-constructed instance. Contrast relic/belt_buckle, where the analogous missing reset is live because nothing shadows it.
